chatgpttoolkit_description.message: Enhances your ChatGPT experience with useful features like a Auto-Fill prompt text from URL, common prompts after response, and much more.

options_header_subtitle.message: Manage your custom prompt buttons shown in ChatGPT conversations.

options_tab_initial_desc.message: Shown on the ChatGPT home page, before you start a conversation.

options_tab_followup_desc.message: Shown below ChatGPT’s latest reply, so you can follow up in one click.

options_modal_alt_placeholder.message: Shown when hovering over the button

options_modal_prompt_help.message: This text will be inserted when the button is clicked.

options_modal_prompt_args_tooltip.message: Replaced with the input box content if it is not empty; otherwise with clipboard content.

options_modal_args_without_autopaste.message: {{args}} is replaced only when “Auto paste clipboard content” is on.

options_modal_auto_paste_help.message: When enabled, clipboard text is appended to the prompt. If the prompt includes {{args}}, it is replaced with clipboard content. If the input box already has content, {{args}} is replaced with that content instead and the clipboard is not read.

options_modal_auto_submit_help.message: When enabled, the submit button is clicked automatically.

options_type_initial_short.message: On a new chat, above the message box

options_type_followup_short.message: After each reply, below the answer

options_validation_required.message: Enter a value for this field.

options_import_help.message: Paste JSON exported from this page, or choose or drop a .json file.

options_confirm_import.message: Are you sure you want to import $1 prompts? This will overwrite your existing settings.

options_confirm_reset.message: Restore the default prompts? All of your custom prompts will be replaced.

options_preview_slot_hint.message: When you press the button, this is filled with the text in the ChatGPT input box, or with the clipboard if the box is empty.

options_import_error_not_array.message: Imported data must be an array.

options_import_error_empty.message: Paste JSON data or choose a file first.

options_import_error_invalid_item.message: Item #$1 is not a prompt object.

options_import_error_missing_fields.message: Prompt #$1 must include text title and prompt fields.

link_builder_intro.message: Turn a prompt into a link that opens your AI chat with the prompt filled in. Save it as a bookmark, paste it into your notes, or make it an address bar shortcut.

link_builder_service_desc.message: The link opens this site and fills in your prompt.

link_builder_custom_url_help.message: For example the URL of a GPT or a project, like https://chatgpt.com/g/…

link_builder_custom_url_invalid.message: This isn’t a valid URL. Example: https://chatgpt.com/g/…

link_builder_custom_url_unsupported.message: The extension doesn’t run on this site, so the prompt won’t be filled in.

link_builder_prompt_placeholder.message: For example: Translate the following into English:

link_builder_prompt_help.message: For an address bar shortcut, use this where the text you type should go:

link_builder_title_help.message: Used for the bookmark, the Markdown link and the shortcut. Leave it empty to use the AI service’s name.

link_builder_auto_submit_help.message: Sends the prompt right after filling it in.

link_builder_paste_image_label.message: Paste the image in your clipboard

link_builder_paste_image_help.message: Attaches the image in your clipboard to the message.

link_builder_image_tool_help.message: Switches to image generation before filling in the prompt.

link_builder_drag_hint.message: Drag the bookmark to your bookmarks bar to save it

link_builder_result_empty.message: Write a prompt to create the link.

link_builder_result_url_problem.message: Enter a valid URL to create the link.

link_builder_copy_error.message: Couldn’t copy to the clipboard. Select the text and copy it manually.

link_builder_search_desc.message: Type the shortcut in the address bar, press Tab, then type your text to send it to the AI.

link_builder_search_step_add.message: Next to “Site search” (“Your site shortcuts” in newer versions), click “Add” and fill in:

link_builder_search_field_url.message: URL with %s in place of query

link_builder_search_shortcut_hint.message: Anything short and easy to type, like ss

link_builder_search_terms_in_prompt.message: The text you type in the address bar replaces %s in the prompt.

link_builder_search_terms_appended.message: The prompt has no %s, so the text you type goes after the prompt.

link_builder_search_settings_error.message: Couldn’t open the settings. Go to chrome://settings/searchEngines in the address bar.

link_builder_templates_desc.message: Pick a template to start from. It replaces the current prompt, and you can keep editing it.

link_builder_import_help.message: Paste a prompt link or Markdown link made with this tool, or a share link from the previous web version of the link builder. It replaces the current settings.

link_builder_import_error.message: This isn’t a prompt link. Paste the full URL.
